flow: ui-path (ChatDriver) — composer insertText + Enter, SSE-streamed answer

steps.note: session snapshot injected (data/chatgpt.com/.session); may land on a consent/auth interstitial first run — click through, then proceed

rpc: underlying wire = POST /backend-api/f/conversation (SSE, text/event-stream; events seen: stream_start, status_message, conversation_id, turn_complete; chunk-delta event literal composed dynamically — confirm on live capture). Request fields (bundle): model_slug, model_slug_advanced, chatreq_token (optional), client_tools, history_and_training_disabled, conversation_mode {kind: PrimaryAssistant|GizmoInteraction, gizmo_id}, parent_message_id. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> + csrfToken, session seeded via /api/auth/session. The UI path drives the site's own JS so no proto reconstruction needed.
stealth: real session, trusted inputs, site's own send handler — indistinguishable from the user typing
